The '''Crabclaw Caves''' is a dungeon found south of the [[Woodcutting Guild]] in [[Great Kourend]]. Access to the caves requires partial completion of [[The Depths of Despair]] [[quest]]. If players attempt to enter the [[cave (Crabclaw Caves)|cave]] without starting the quest, they will not be able to enter. 

You are able to set up a [[dwarf multicannon]] inside the cave to kill a [[King Sand Crab|king sand crab]] for the [[Kourend & Kebos Diary|easy Kourend & Kebos Diary]]. The dwarf multicannon will not target immune targets such as sand crabs or sand snakes, however. 

{{Map|1644,3449|r=4|mtype=square|caption=The location of the cave's entrance.|align=left|width=250|height=250|zoom=1}}
The caves contain an additional place to train on [[Sand Crab|sand crab]]s, with three crabs next to each other in one spot, and another spot with four crabs next to each other. There are also two smaller caves with several king sand crabs.

During The Depths of Despair, players must travel to the very end of the caves, and climbing down the [[tunnel entrance (Crabclaw Caves)|tunnel entrance]] to find [[Artur Hosidius]], who is searching for the [[Royal Accord of Twill]], and finds a [[Sand Snake|sand snake]] guarding the [[chest (The Depths of Despair)|chest]] containing it. After the quest is complete, players can no longer access the bottom area, with the player stating "I don't really want to go down there again."

== Transportation ==
*[[Skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Woodcutting Guild]] - run a short distance south to the cave entrance.
* [[Spirit tree]] planted in a [[spirit tree patch]] south-east of the [[Forthos Ruin]] near [[Hosidius]] - run south-west to the cave entrance.
*[[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] - run south-west to the cave entrance from the Hosidius West station of the minecart network.

==Trivia==
*A part of [[Skotizo]]'s lair can be seen in the northernmost area of the caves.
